terms.summary: UN Comtrade data are copyrighted by the United Nations. Its re-dissemination FAQ says transformed data "is no longer subject to copyright restrictions" and that re-dissemination means reusing the data as-is on other platforms. This file is a transformed extract: selected fields for one HS heading per company, kept with derived rankings and the SHA-256 of each raw payload. Raw payloads are not committed.
terms.attribution: Source: UN Comtrade (United Nations Statistics Division), retrieved via the public preview API.
